crossRefs.note: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and…
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he…
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier…
Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all…
promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by…
Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

translations.web: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.
translations.bsb: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
translations.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
translations.asv: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
